run_sd3_dreambooth_lora_training: run SD3 DreamBooth LoRA training on a miniature dataset with configurable optimizer and scheduler
create_dreambooth_dataset: create a DreamBoothDataset that loads images, computes hashes, and maps precomputed text embeddings from a parquet file
log_validation_images: log validation images generated from a StableDiffusion3Pipeline to tensorboard or wandb during training
save_model_card_hub: save a model card README and upload trained LoRA weights to a Hugging Face Hub repository
parse_training_arguments: parse command-line arguments for SD3 DreamBooth LoRA training including data dirs, learning rate, and checkpoint settings
